title: Iterated tuple map
statement: Let $f$ be a function on bit strings, let $\ell_1,\ell_2$ assign natural numbers to bit strings, and let $i$ be a natural number. On input $z$, form the $(i+1)$-fold iterated first projection of $z$, where each projection takes the first component of a pair parse and returns the empty string if parsing fails. Use this string to construct the unary paired length encoding from $\ell_1,\ell_2$, then apply the $(i+1)$-level tuple decoder with base map $n\mapsto f(n)$ and the padded second-component decoder, using that encoding and $z$ as inputs.
caveat: The definitions of the base map and the projections and decoders used in this construction are not all included in the provided definitions.
